Effective September 24, 2026 · Version 2.5

This Acceptable Use Policy ("AUP") sets out prohibited uses of the Remvoll Service and supplements the Terms of Service. It exists to keep the Service lawful, secure, and true to its purpose. Capitalized terms have the meanings given in the Terms. By using the Service you agree to this AUP.

We welcome honest reviews, videos, and other content about Remvoll. 5. Reporting violations

If you become aware of a violation of this AUP, please report it to support@remvoll.com. For suspected security vulnerabilities, follow the responsible-disclosure process in our Security Practices.

6. Enforcement and consequences

We may investigate suspected violations and take any action we consider appropriate, including issuing warnings, restricting features, and suspending or terminating access, in accordance with the Terms of Service. Where conduct is unlawful, we may be required to cooperate with law-enforcement authorities — though, because this build holds no user data on servers, there is typically nothing we could produce. We reserve the right to modify this AUP from time to time; material changes will be communicated as described in the Terms.
